name: Shioya Kazuhito
source:
Director of an osteopathic Clinic. Age unknown. Unknown background. He runs a modest clinic in a corner of a shopping street.

He is a skilled chiropractor, but he also offers other types of treatment in secret.

[Translated from the [url=http://iranko.com/triumph/saimin02/]official website[/url]]
